title: Hiding all nine toggleable columns is allowed and the table still shows Customer, Subtotal and the totals Subtotal
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. You are on the report with data.
steps: 1. Open the column selector and turn all nine toggles off.
expected: 1. All nine columns can be hidden — nothing blocks the last toggle.
2. The table still renders the Customer and Subtotal columns.
3. The totals row still shows its Subtotal.
